python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(answers)==88
for item,answer in zip(items,answers):
 assert answer['item_id']==item['item_id']
 assert answer['answer'] in item['options']
 assert answer['confidence'] in ('high','low')
 assert isinstance(answer['note'],str)
assert len({a['item_id'] for a in answers})==88
counts=collections.Counter(i['options'][a['answer']] for i,a in zip(items,answers))
print('Validated count, order, unique IDs, option letters and confidence values.')
print(json.dumps(dict(counts),sort_keys=True))
print('Low confidence:',sum(a['confidence']=='low' for a in answers))
